decision: Reject as a new independent source. All 74 image names map to Matterport source basenames. Initial visual examples also match Matterport scenes. Filename matching alone is not a claim of pixel equality.

preview_exposure_incident.cause: Initial audit sampled upstream train before checking whether it repackaged an existing source with different splits.
preview_exposure_incident.consequence: Do not describe the existing Matterport test as visually blind or use it as final independent qualification. Keep all its existing split restrictions intact; no images move into training. Final qualification requires fresh representative real-scene recordings.
preview_exposure_incident.repair: Added hash-bound filename exclusion before any training-preview image read. Regression fixture omits all candidate pixels and uses invalid reference bytes, proving metadata-only rejection. Re-audit excludes all 74 aliases without producing previews.
